source: Team demo content, not medical advice; needs flight-surgeon review

questions.text: Do they react when you tap their shoulders and shout?
Are they breathing normally? Look, listen and feel for 10 seconds.

summary.LOW: They are awake and breathing. Stay with them.
summary.MODERATE: They are hard to wake. Lay them on their side now.
summary.CRITICAL: No reaction or strange breathing. Start chest pushes now.

LOW.text: Stay with them and keep talking to them.
Ask what happened and how they feel.
Alert the base if confused or sleepy.

CRITICAL.text: Lay them on their side if breathing.
Start chest pushes if not breathing.
Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest.
Use the heart shock box when it comes.

callBaseWhen: Call the base immediately if they do not respond.
